0.0:
Are you here to join in World Event Day? #bIt's only happening on 3/24/2015!#k
You can complete the event by playing Star Bingo and 1 vs 100 Rock-Paper-Scissors #b5 times#k!
#e#r[Caution!]#n
#rYour plays won't count if you don't stay until the end, even when you are dropped from the game.#k
Participate to the end of all games, even if you don't win!

0.msg: Completing the event is quite simply.\r\n#bPlay 5 games total#k of either #bStar Bingo#k (every hour on the hour) or #b1 vs 100 Rock-Paper-Scissors#k (every hour at the 20-min mark) that run between 12PM-10PM.\n

1.msg: #rHowever your records will not count if you exit a game in the middle. Even if you are dropped from the game, you should still stay until the very end.#k

2.msg: You can't be a winner without being a challenger!

no.0: Tsk, tsk... Challenges bring forth a sense of accomplishment. You should really participate because the World Event Day ONLY runs today.

1.0: Did you enjoy World Event Day?

0.msg: Wait a minute, #h0#... You're that fiery-eyed competitor playing Rock-Paper-Scissors?! Let's see if you earned a reward for your participation. The reward...

1.msg: #bwill be revealed after this commercial break.#k

2.msg: AH! Okay, okay... I just wanted to say that line once in my life. I've let #bPom Pom#k know I acknowledge you as my apprentice. Find Pom Pom in the Star Planet entrance lobby... There must be a lot of people there to get their rewards. In that case, #bjoin the line!

default.0: Either you didn't participate 5 times or the participation record did not count due to exiting early. I suggest you hurry before it ends!
